title: Constant weight code A(35,6,6)
statement: Find binary words of length 35, each with exactly 6 ones and any two differing in at least 6 positions, as many as possible: a lower bound on A(35,6,6). The best known lower bound in Andries Brouwer's table of constant weight codes is 2,348 (our code); the best known upper bound is 3,249. A code with more words improves it.
submission: Text file: one word per line, the 6 positions of its ones, distinct integers from 1..35 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Andries Brouwer's table of constant weight codes (aeb.win.tue.nl/codes/Andw.html), A(35,6,6) >= 2,348: our code, listed since 2026-11-05 (before it 2,217); read 6 Nov 2026 13:28 UTC (page last modified 5 Nov 2026 22:34 GMT)

provenance.keeper: A. E. Brouwer, table of constant weight codes
provenance.revision: table read on the date given

score: the number of code words (more is better)
quantavane_note: our object is the best known entry of the source table
